title: Data Mesh Architecture
description: A data mesh architecture diagram with domain-oriented data ownership across Sales, Marketing, and Finance domains, each exposing self-serve data products through APIs with quality SLAs, governed by a federated data platform with a shared catalog and cross-domain query engine. This template models the paradigm shift from centralized data teams to domain-owned data products, applying microservices principles to data architecture. Essential for organizations scaling data operations beyond centralized data warehouse bottlenecks.
